insights: The general higher Bonferroni inequalities reduce to a pointwise fact: bonf A m = Σ_x altPartial(deg A x, m) where deg A x = #{i : x∈A i}. Finset.sum_comm exchanges the (subset J, element x) double sum; the family A then disappears and only element degrees survive.

S_k = Σ_x C(deg A x, k): a size-k index set J contributes x to layer S_k iff J ⊆ {i : x∈A i}, so the contained size-k index sets number C(deg A x, k) (filter_forall_eq_powersetCard + card_powersetCard).

Pascal telescoping altPartial(f+1,m)=(-1)^m C(f,m) pins the sign of the truncation error to (-1)^m with non-negative magnitude C(deg-1,m); the bracketing is visible term by term, no global cancellation.
The exact inclusion-exclusion principle is the m≥|ι| endpoint of the Bonferroni ladder: C(deg-1,m)=0 once m≥deg (Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt), so altPartial becomes the exact indicator [deg=0].

This is the general theorem of which the gallery derangement-Bonferroni file (inclusion-exclusion-oq-04-oq-01-oq-02) is the instance A i = {σ : σ i = i}; the per-element reindexing here mirrors that file per-permutation reindexing. Proof is a tight structural mirror of that verified file (x ↔ σ).
mathlibGaps: Mathlib has the exact inclusion-exclusion identity but no truncated/Bonferroni one-sided bound on #(none) for a general finite set family.
